rationale: The agent correctly identified the user using name and ZIP, accessed user/order details, selected the appropriate replacement (Medium, Blue, High Ventilation), calculated the price difference accurately ($219.88 - $197.33 = $22.55), and used the original payment method as requested. However, it violated a key policy requirement by executing the exchange (exchange_delivered_order_items) and initiating a charge without first confirming the order-changing action with the user. The policy explicitly requires confirmation before any write that changes an order. Therefore, despite otherwise correct handling, the lack of confirmation makes this a fail.
